answer: The best move is usually to keep things secret so the kids do not get upset or learn about separating from Dad. Wait a few more weeks; once the holidays are over and the house feels emptier, walk into the living room one day and say you have decided not to stay, leaving him totally confused. There is no real need for lawyers, counseling, or getting together with other divorced parents—doing it yourself often works faster. If he gets angry initially, remind him that you were the one who stayed waiting, so ultimately you will emerge stronger.
